R22-F2.note: R22-F2, reproduced independently on this host. This controller declares 153 REPOSITORY_SOURCE entries which resolve to 142 distinct git blobs once the manifest's own blob is included. source_ref.blobs above carries all 142, because that is the true set and COMPLETE_MANIFEST_FILE_BLOB_COVERAGE in source-publication.mjs requires every declared source file to appear in it. Three separate ceilings of 133 sit inside the FROZEN controller and every one of them refuses this set: context.mjs:113 capacityDelta.source_refs_maximum=133, which the approval and applicability documents must match byte for byte; context.mjs:134 CLOSED_SOURCE_REF_MAXIMUM, a literal blobs.length<=133; and source-publication.mjs:25 COMPLETE_BOUNDED_SOURCE_SET, a literal refs.length<=133. NO GA CAN BE CONSTRUCTED AGAINST CONTROLLER 389fee9b7e533041119838df59706cc2166b44497369cca419b1dc125e9a98ec UNTIL THOSE THREE LITERALS ADMIT AT LEAST 142. Re-issuing the capacity materials alone does NOT achieve that: a new approval carrying source_refs_maximum=160 fails same(a.capacity_delta,capacityDelta) at REAL_EXACT_CAPACITY_APPROVAL_REQUIRED, and the other two ceilings are code, not policy. Raising the ceiling therefore requires a controller change, which contradicts the freeze. This document records the true set rather than a truncated one so the refusal happens at the ceiling, attributably, instead of at COMPLETE_MANIFEST_FILE_BLOB_COVERAGE with a manifest that silently under-declares its own sources.
